question: If something other than this appears, what connection with another can it have if it is self-established?
premises: Something other than this may appear.
A connection with another would require dependence.
inference: Even apparent otherness has no real dependence on another, since it is self-established in appearance.
uncertainties: The force of svasiddhaṃ may be epistemic or ontological.
plain_english: If something other than this appears, that very thing is self-established; what connection with another could there be here?
